name: Jos

queries.query: Jos Plateau State official cadastral map land registry PLAGIS Jos North Jos South
queries.result: Official Plateau State PLAGIS describes separate registry and cadastral platforms. Its cadastral-zone schedule names Jos North and Jos South settlements, and the 2024 financial statement records a specific “Mapping for Cadastral Jos at Scale 1:2000” line. No anonymous full-parcel feature endpoint or safe feature schema was found.

queries.query: Jos Plateau State cadastral map Hausa taswirar fili Jos filaye PLAGIS
queries.result: Binciken Hausa ya samo shafin hukuma na PLAGIS da jerin yankunan cadastral na Greater Jos, ciki har da Jos North da Jos South. Bayanai sun tabbatar da ayyukan cadastral a yankin Jos, amma ba a samo hanyar jama’a ta sauke cikakkun siffofin filaye ba.

portals.observation: Official PLAGIS page says it operates registry (land administration, deeds and property valuation) and cadastral (geoinformatics, surveying, GIS analysis and map production) platforms.
Official rate index lists a downloadable Cadastral Zones document and Greater Jos survey and other land charges.
Six-page PLAGIS schedule delineates cadastral sectors and lists numerous Jos North/Jos South settlements, including in Greater Jos.
2024 financial statement includes a specific “Mapping for Cadastral Jos at Scale 1:2000” item and expansion of land-record/deeds registries.
Official service shell exposes Login and Register your Property links; no anonymous parcel map/feature route or property field schema was documented.

verifiedParcelResponse.limitations: No parcel feature response or full polygon was retrieved.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: PLAGIS publishes Greater Jos cadastral sectors containing Jos North and Jos South urban localities; the state separately budgets cadastral mapping of Jos. The WUP city point is not matched to a particular sector or parcel, and complete public vector coverage is unverified.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official city-area cadastral planning/registry records are confirmed. Public sources reviewed did not publish an anonymous full-polygon parcel endpoint with safe attributes; no parcel feature request was made.

registryBasis: Plateau State PLAGIS city-area cadastral mapping and registry are established through the Jos-specific cadastral-zone schedule and 2024 “Mapping for Cadastral Jos” budget line. This confirms local cadastral administration, not anonymous public polygon access.
technicalBlocker: The public PLAGIS shell offers property registration/login and published documents, but no anonymous full-parcel vector route or privacy-safe feature schema was verified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether PLAGIS exposes complete parcel polygons publicly and whether the WUP population centroid lies in a mapped/available sector remain unverified.
nextStep: If a public map endpoint is found, inspect its documented properties and city-sector coverage before querying any parcel. Do not submit a registration or private property identifier.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: Source discovery only. No full parcel polygons, owner/address data, account credentials, tokens or feature responses were retained.
